text:
Elaine (Sales): Heads up — Meridian Bank POC. They need an air-gapped/on‑prem option for SCIM provisioning, support for multiple IdPs per tenant (Okta + AzureAD), delegated admin roles scoped by domain, and RBAC mapping to their internal entitlements. Also they pushed a security questionnaire and asked for a pricing ballpark for Dedicated + Private.
Sophia (SE): Got it. Quick clarifying Qs: How often do they want SCIM deltas? Are they expecting JIT provisioning on login, or full syncs from AD sync? Any required attributes beyond email/displayName/roles?
Elaine (Sales): On call tomorrow — they said daily delta syncs for ~120k users, JIT for contractor flows, and need role -> group mapping (entitlements). They also asked about delegated admin UIs (tenant admins can invite users, manage groups).
Aj (Infra): Air‑gapped + SCIM means we ship a Private control plane + an on‑prem SCIM proxy. For delta syncs at that scale we should use incremental syncs + pagination, and mTLS between their sync agent and our proxy. We'll need a service account cert + optional client cert rotation.
Katie (Security): I'll flag the security questionnaire. We can provide SOC2 + KMS integration details. Need to confirm data residency for backups and logs when Private. @Elaine please upload the questionnaire link.
SecurityBot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood-secure/meridian/questionnaire-2026.pdf :white_check_mark:
Sophia (SE): Proposal for provisioning flow: deploy a local SCIM connector that writes to our on‑prem cache, connector does periodic delta pulls and exposes an internal API for JIT. RBAC mapping via SCIM custom extension: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User -> roles. Sample mapping snippet below.
Sophia (SE): ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User","urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@meridian.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "Alice","familyName": "Ng"},
  "emails": [{"value":"alice@meridian.com","primary":true}],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"roles": ["teller","auditor"]}
}
```
Aj (Infra): For delegated admins we can use SCIM groups + a custom role claim. Our proxy will translate SCIM group membership to internal RBAC grants. We'll need to confirm max group membership size and rate limits — suggest 200 req/s headroom during sync.
Elaine (Sales): Pricing — rough rough numbers to put on the table: Dedicated reserved pool + Private deployment license = $45k/mo reserved + $150k one‑time private deployment/license + $12k one‑time on‑site install & validation. Add premium SSO connector support + SLA for an extra $5k/mo. This is ballpark for first pass.
Sophia (SE): Technical blockers: multi‑IdP per tenant means we store per‑tenant IdP configs and canonicalize attributes. We should validate nameID formats (transient vs persistent) and support both SAML and OIDC assertions. Also confirm Meridian's session length and SLO expectations.
Katie (Security): On questionnaire — I'll draft answers for data flows, key management (we support customer KMS/HSM for Private), network isolation, and audit log retention. Need product team to confirm erase-on-termination timeline for Private instances.
Elaine (Sales): Action items: 1) Sophia to draft SCIM connector architecture + confirm rate limits (due EOD PST). 2) Aj to write client cert rotation plan and on‑prem install checklist. 3) Katie to start questionnaire draft and note KMS/HSM options. 4) I'll send the pricing ballpark and schedule the POC kickoff for Tue 09:00 PT.
Sophia (SE): I'll ping infra for exact throughput numbers and post a short runbook in the thread before EOD.
Aj (Infra): Will add cert rotation and network diagram. Also recommend we prepackage a limited test dataset (10k users) for the POC to validate delta behavior.
Elaine (Sales): Perfect — thanks team. I'll loop Meridian and confirm Tue 09:00 PT. :calendar:
